Definition
[Hyperbolic straightening] \group straightening Source: thurston:page-0137

For vertices $v_0,\ldots ,v_k\in H^n$, the straight simplex is the canonical parametrization of their convex hull obtained in the quadratic-form model by central projection of the affine barycentric simplex. A singular simplex in a complete hyperbolic manifold is straightened by lifting it to $H^n$, replacing the lift by the straight simplex with the same vertices, and projecting back. This operation extends linearly to a chain map \[ \operatorname {straight}:C_*(M)\to C_*(M) \] chain-homotopic to the identity and satisfying $\| \operatorname {straight}(c)\| \leq \| c\| $.
